description: This file defines a Locator class and a FrameLocator class used for selecting, interacting with, and inspecting DOM elements within a web automation framework (likely Playwright). It includes methods for element queries, actions, and diagnostics, supporting complex selector composition and frame navigation.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: A class representing a DOM element locator capable of performing actions, queries, and assertions on matched elements within a frame.

classes.name: FrameLocator
classes.description: A class for within-frame element targeting, allowing for chained locators within nested frames.

methods.name: locator
methods.description: Creates a new Locator or FrameLocator by appending a selector or another Locator.

methods.name: getByTestId
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements with specified test ID.

methods.name: getByAltText
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements with specified alt text.

methods.name: getByLabel
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements with specified label text.

methods.name: getByPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements with specified placeholder text.

methods.name: getByText
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements containing specified text.

methods.name: getByTitle
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements with specified title.

methods.name: getByRole
methods.description: Returns a Locator for elements with specified role.

methods.name: frameLocator
methods.description: Creates a FrameLocator for nested frames.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a Locator for the first element matching the selector.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a Locator for the last element matching the selector.

methods.name: nth

methods.name: owner
methods.description: Returns a Locator representing the current frame's root element.

methods.name: elementHandle
methods.description: Returns an ElementHandle for the matched element.

methods.name: elementHandles
methods.description: Returns an array of ElementHandles for all matched elements.

methods.name: isEnabled

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if an element is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for a file input element.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a select element.

methods.name: selectText
methods.description: Selects the text content of an element.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap/click on touch devices.

methods.name: textContent

methods.name: uncheck
